description:
• Brand introduction:Royal Koas is a dynamic lifestyle brand that blends fashion, fandom, and function. We specialize in graphic T-shirts, hoodies, long sleeves, hats, socks, backpacks, and miscellaneous items like posters and fandom accessories. We even carry skateboards and skate gear to keep our customers riding in style. With exclusive designs from trusted suppliers like Ripple Junction and Rock Off Trade, our merchandise features iconic trademarks from Disney, blockbuster movies, TV shows, and beloved bands—making us a one-of-a-kind destination for pop culture enthusiasts. 
• Product description:

Stay cozy and stylish in our Hoodies, crafted for fans who want to wear their passions proudly. Made from a premium cotton-polyester blend, this hoodie offers warmth and durability without sacrificing comfort. Featuring an exclusive licensed design from [Disney/TV Show/Bands], it’s perfect for layering during chilly days or adding flair to your streetwear look. The front kangaroo pocket and adjustable drawstring hood combine functionality with fashion, making this your go-to piece for any season.

  • Material: 70% Cotton, 30% Polyester
  • Fit: Relaxed, unisex
  • Features: Kangaroo pocket, drawstring hood
  • Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

Elevate your casual wardrobe with our exclusive Graphic T-Shirt. Made from ultra-soft, breathable cotton, this tee combines comfort and style for everyday wear. Featuring bold, licensed artwork from [Disney/TV Show/Bands], it’s a must-have for any fan. The unisex fit and durable print make it perfect for pairing with jeans, shorts, or layering under a jacket. Whether you're hitting the streets or lounging at home, this T-shirt keeps you looking effortlessly cool.

  • Material: 100% Cotton
  • Fit: Unisex, true-to-size
  • Care: Machine wash cold, tumble dry low

 
• USP (Unique Selling Point): Partner with Royal Koas and unlock access to a brand that combines exclusive licensed designs from iconic franchises like Disney, blockbuster movies, and top bands with premium, high-demand apparel and accessories. Our unique edge in the market ensures strong customer appeal, competitive pricing, and excellent commission opportunities for affiliates who want to represent a brand that stands out.
• Payment terms: 

  • Commission Structure:

    • Affiliates earn a [X%] commission on every qualifying sale made through their unique referral link.
    • Commissions are calculated based on the net sales amount (excluding taxes, shipping, and discounts).

  • Payment Schedule:

    • Commissions are paid on a [monthly/bi-weekly/quarterly] basis, typically within [X days] of the end of the payment period.
    • A minimum payout threshold of [$XX] applies. If the threshold isn’t met, earnings will roll over to the next payment period.

  • Payment Method:

    • Payments are processed via [PayPal, direct deposit, or other payment options]. Affiliates must provide accurate payment details during registration.

  • Refunds and Chargebacks:

    • If a referred sale is refunded or charged back, the corresponding commission will be deducted from the affiliate’s next payment.

  • Tax Compliance:

    • Affiliates are responsible for reporting and paying any applicable taxes on their earnings. Royal Koas may request tax forms, such as a W-9 or W-8BEN, to comply with legal requirements.

  • Program Updates:

    • Royal Koas reserves the right to update payment terms with prior notice to affiliates.
